items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: so they put me up on Friday. Yeah. And I beat Friday.

ctx.x: Yeah, so they put me up on Friday. Yeah. And I beat Friday. At least the hometown went for me, you know. And I beat him dancing. And so that made me think then that I was a great dancer, North Van Al-Smoke-Sale. So I said, well, if I'm that great, I'm going to leave him. So I did. I left home with W.M. Morris Carnival.
Well, you aren't so different, I think, from the rest of us, Mr. Jones. We figure out what's easiest for us to do with it. We don't like hard work either.
